unavailable.description: This server template does not expose a supported Minecraft mod or plugin feature.

mods.manualDownloadHint: This version is hosted outside the provider and has to be downloaded and uploaded manually.

manualDownloadHints.generic: This version is hosted outside the provider and has to be downloaded and uploaded manually.

mods.filesLockedNotice: Files are locked while a modpack is being installed.

toasts.updateFailed: The resources could not be updated.

browse.title: Browse mods and plugins
browse.description: Search Modrinth, CurseForge, Hangar and SpigotMC for resources that fit this server. Client-only mods are left out.

installed.title: Installed
installed.empty: Nothing installed through the browser yet.

unmanaged.title: Uploaded by hand
unmanaged.description_one: {{count}} file was added outside the browser, so it has no version to track.
unmanaged.description_other: {{count}} files were added outside the browser, so they have no version to track.

unreadable.title: Could not be checked
unreadable.description: The node did not answer for {{types}}, so what is installed there could not be verified. Nothing was changed.

pack.chooseDescription: A server runs one pack. Installing one links it here, so its version can be switched and checked for updates later. Only packs with a server side are listed.
pack.upToDate: This pack is on its newest version.
pack.stopRequired: The server has to be stopped before a pack can be installed or switched.
pack.unlinkedLoader: This pack was installed before packs were linked to a loader, so its versions cannot be listed. Install it again to relink it.
pack.noModsOnDisk: None of the pack's mods are on disk any more.

dialog.title: Install {{title}}
dialog.description: The pack is downloaded and unpacked before anything is written, so the server is only touched once the pack is known to be usable.
dialog.backupHint: A backup is taken before anything is written. If it fails, the install does not start.
dialog.backupUnavailable: Unavailable: this node has no backup storage configured for the server.
dialog.wipeHint: Clears the current mod jars so the result matches the pack. Turn this off to merge the pack into what is already installed.
dialog.wipeWarning: Existing mods will be deleted and there is no backup to restore from. Mod configuration shipped with the pack will also overwrite what is on the server.

modpackInstall.failedDefault: The installation failed. Nothing was changed if it failed before the install step.
modpackInstall.filesLocked: File editing is disabled until this finishes.
modpackInstall.failures_one: {{count}} file could not be fetched (most often a CurseForge author blocking third-party downloads): {{list}}
modpackInstall.failures_other: {{count}} files could not be fetched (most often a CurseForge author blocking third-party downloads): {{list}}
